messages:
mel: Quick ask for field enablement: can we make a tight 1-pager targeted at compliance & platform teams that covers governance controls, deployment paths, SLA bullets, a short benchmark note, and a copyable inbound routing rule? Need something handable during discovery.

ash: Yep. Proposed micro-structure: 1) 2-line opener focused on governance risk reduction, 2) three governance controls with one-liners, 3) deployment matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) with compliance fit, 4) SLA bullets + what triggers escalation, 5) benchmark sentence + variability note, 6) routing snippet + 2 email subjects.

gabe: For governance controls callouts: "audit logs & immutable event stream", "BYOK + optional HSM (FIPS 140-2)", "regional tenancy & export controls". Add reference icons for quick scan.

lynn: SLA bullets we can draft non-legal: "Bronze: basic availability + monitoring"; "Silver: uptime + latency guardrails"; "Gold: 24/7 incident response + financial recourse". Avoid raw percentages in the one-pager, link to SLA doc for specifics.

ash: Benchmark suggestion (conservative, field-friendly): "Representative dedicated pool (mixed-gen): p50 ~ 30ms, p95 ~ 85-110ms; caching commonly reduces repeated-prefix token cost ~30% on customer prompts." Add note: "Results depend on model families and prompt shape."

mel: Love the conservative phrasing. For deployment matrix please include one-line fit statements: hosted = quick evals and lower compliance needs; dedicated = reserved capacity, best for production throughput; private = VPC/on-prem for strict regs.

gabe: Routing snippet (copyable) for inbound automation:
```
# inbound routing rule (pseudo)
if lead.tags contains "regulated" or lead.industry in ["healthcare","finance","government"]:
  assign.queue = "enterprise-engage"
  lead.priority = "high"
  add.tags(["compliance","enterprise"])
  if lead.estimated_monthly_tokens >= 2000000:
    notify("#solutions-arch")
    set.escalation = true
else:
  assign.queue = "self-serve"
```

lynn: Two email subject options for SDRs: 1) "[Company] + Redwood: Governance-first LLM serving" 2) "Quick call? SLA-backed LLMs for regulated workflows"

ash: Also include a short AE-ready opener they can paste: "We help regulated teams run LLM features with BYOK, regional tenancy, and SLA-backed hosting so you can ship without expanding security burden."

product-bot: draft_uploaded: https://drive.company/redwood/marketing/governance-snapshot-v1 (perm: marketing-edit) :white_check_mark:

mel: Next steps: ash to finalize 1-pager copy, gabe to confirm HSM/BYOK phrasing with infra/security, lynn to map the AE opener into the enablement card. Target: have final deck + Figma mock by EOD Friday.

gabe: I'll verify HSM/FIPS mention and confirm audit retention default (we usually reference 90 days, extendable per contract).

mel: Thanks team — once locked we'll bundle the PDF + copyable routing rule into the field kit and add to the webinar landing for compliance deep-dive. :tada:
